device.description: 14-bit 200 kSPS single-channel pseudo-differential SAR ADC with SPI serial output
device.note: tlc3541.pdf (SLAS345) p.1 pinouts, p.3 terminal functions, p.4 recommended operating conditions, p.6 timing requirements, p.11-12 control and timing (reset cycle, conversion, serial output data format, SPI CPOL 0 / CPHA 1), p.16 binary output format and auto-power down

pages: p.1 (pinouts), p.3 (terminal functions), p.4 (ROC), p.6 (timing), p.11-12 (reset, conversion, output format, SPI mode), p.16 (binary format, auto-power down)
notModeled: analog input, external reference (REF); the result is the 0 V code (0000h)
sampling (20 SCLKs from the 5th SCLK) and the conversion start after the 24th SCLK falling edge: modeled as a 2.67 us conversion started at CS rising; SDO carries the previous cycle's result (p.11)
power-on RESET/initialization cycle (CS low for 1 to 8 SCLK falling edges) and the 3FC0h code output after a reset cycle or a prematurely terminated conversion (p.11)
SDO goes Hi-Z at the 17th SCLK rising edge; modeled as Hi-Z after the 16-bit frame (idle z) and at CS rising
auto-power down after each conversion (woken by CS falling) - no effect on the bus
SCLK frequency limits (100 kHz to 15 MHz), sample time limits
variants: TLC3541: single-ended AIN, separate FS pin (pin 7), SCLK on pin 5; TLC3545: pseudo-differential AIN(+)/AIN(-), SCLK on pin 7, no FS. Same 14-bit frame and timing.
